transcript.text: Thank you, Dev. As executive sponsor, I want to address each of the points that have been raised and add my perspective. First, on the quarterly independent program commitment I put on the record earlier — I want to be clear that this was a promise I made directly to both group leads, and I believe it's a non-negotiable operating commitment that should be written into the governance structure. Each network must retain the autonomy to run one independently chosen program per quarter, even under a shared planning structure. Second, on Rina's observations about the heated exchanges — I take those seriously, and I support the recommendation for an independent facilitator for the first six shared meetings. As sponsor, I want to make sure both groups feel supported in working through event ownership friction constructively. Third, on Evan's scheduling constraint — accessibility for all organizers is essential, and I support fixing the recurring planning meeting at Tuesday 10:00 as an operating commitment. And finally, on Dev's anonymous feedback requirement — I agree that needs to be built into the process before the charter is adopted. I'd encourage Marisol to incorporate all of these elements into the governance structure before granting approval. I'm happy to continue the round-robin if there are further points to discuss.
